name: gluth
_comment: FULLY LEVEL-2 Gluth, strategy (A2): dedicated mage/hunter KITERS orbit the chow spawn area and snare the chow; OFF-TANKS tank the gathered chow at the back (spawn area, away from Gluth NE); everyone else burns Gluth + bursts the decimated chow. See BossNotes/Gluth.md. TUNED FOR 25-MAN. Shapes used: attack max_hp_pct/max_range (burn pivot), encounter_active detect:nearest + class (gate threat-independent / class-specific roles), adds_near (off-tank 'kite when swarmed' switch), snare_area (kiter + off-tank casts), stack_point hold (off-tanks DON'T fall through to generic combat and rip Gluth -- the pull-aggro fix), tank_swap watch:maintank (Mortal Wound rotation). Layout: Gluth NE (3319,-3120); ranged/healers cluster (3300,-3140); spawn area / kite ring / OT hold all at (3280,-3160). Coords + spell lists are RELOAD-tunable. NOTE: ALL mages+hunters kite full-time (zero Gluth DPS from them); if that's too much DPS loss, trim the class list (e.g. "hunter" only) via reload. A/B with .rjson off.

rules._comment: MAIN TANK holds Gluth at the NE anchor then attacks (stack@2 -> yields within 3y -> attack@1). Threat detect -- the MT threatens Gluth.

KITERS (mages + hunters): orbit the chow spawn area (3280,-3160, r15) and snare whatever chow is nearest, slowing/rooting their march on Gluth so the off-tanks can gather them. class:"mage,hunter" + detect:nearest (they never threaten Gluth, so a threat gate would never fire for them, and the threat-based DPS/cluster rules below simply don't apply to them either). snare_area@7 fires the first known + off-CD snare on the nearest chow within 30y, then yields to orbit_point@6 which keeps them circling. Full-time -- they don't DPS Gluth. (If Frost Nova won't fire on an enemy target, switch its rule to target:self via reload.)

RANGED DPS + HEALERS cluster SW of the tank (away from the north door). stack_point yields within 8y so ranged fall through to attack Gluth and healers heal. (Mages/hunters match role 'ranged' but don't threaten Gluth, so this threat-detect rule never fires for them -- they kite.)
ALL DPS tunnel Gluth (melee close via the un-suppressed 'reach melee'; non-kiter ranged nuke from the cluster).

DECIMATE-BURN PIVOT, melee reach. max_hp_pct:10 only sees chow at/below 10% HP (only true right after Decimate), so it self-gates to the burn; boss:"" disables the fallback so outside the burn it yields and DPS stay on Gluth. role 'dps' excludes tanks/healers; max_range:10 keeps melee from chasing (chow come to Gluth).

DECIMATE-BURN PIVOT, ranged reach. role 'ranged' with max_range:35 catches decimated chow crossing the room. (Kiters don't fire this -- no Gluth threat -- they keep rooting the pack instead, which also helps the burn.)

OFF-TANKS tank the gathered chow at the back (spawn area 3280,-3160). (a) tank_swap@5 -- Mortal Wound rotation: assist #0 covers Gluth while the MT's >=5 stacks decay. (b) snare_area@2 -- cast the first known tank AoE-threat spell on the nearest chow within 12y so chow stick to the OT (their AoE threat is what actually pulls chow off the march to Gluth). (c) stack_point hold:true @1 -- park at the hold and OWN the tick when there's nothing to do, so the OT does NOT fall through to generic combat and run at Gluth (the pull-aggro fix). detect:nearest because off-tanks never threaten Gluth.

OFF-TANK KITES when swarmed: if >=6 chow pile within 9y, orbit the spawn ring (3280,-3160, r18) so it isn't bursted -- the C++ OT_KITE_THRESHOLD as data. orbit_point@3 beats the hold stack@1 and the snare@2 while active; tank_swap@5 still wins over it.

suppress._comment: Everyone engaged: no formation-follow / master-follow during the fight (it would re-pull bots toward the master and fight the Level-2 positioning).

OFF-TANKS (threat-independent via detect:nearest): zero dps/tank assist, flee, formation, follow so they don't charge Gluth and rip aggro off the MT, and so their hold/orbit isn't dragged off. 'taunt spell' is NOT listed (tank_swap force-runs it anyway).

KITERS (mages/hunters, threat-independent): same suppression so they don't assist the MT's target (Gluth), follow the master, or flee -- they just orbit the spawn area and snare. orbit_point owns the tick so they never fall through to attack Gluth.

MAIN TANK: zero its own 'taunt spell' so it doesn't re-taunt Gluth back during a Mortal Wound swap (the MT holds via attack threat; the only intended handoff is the swap). The off-tank's swap taunt is unaffected (different bot + force-run).
